reviewScope: All 35 start/solution pairs in three original-resolution contact sheets; additional full-resolution gm2001 start/solution, gm1152 solution, gm1851 solution, gm288 UI preview and 885x630 initial board, and the existing gm1699 solution.

observations.result: No blank boards, technical HUD, replacement checkerboard, leftover BASIC selection strip, overlapping modal or visible shader-error magenta in the 70 displayed representative frames. Original day/night backgrounds, grass/stone terrain and original toolbar are present.

Full-resolution gm2001 1280x720 includes its lower underground wall and front board corner. Latest strict Aspect images also include them at885x630. gm288 has its complete lower corner at885x630. This verifies framing for those captures, not arbitrary future camera input.

Latest gm2001 has purple and teal sources, routed surfaces and received pool effects, replacing the older uniformly green Night images. gm1152 also shows a distinct purple route. These colored materials are visibly different from a missing-shader magenta error.

gm2001 solution has a purple flat patch below the front-right pool edge; gm1851 solution has a blue flat patch beneath its front pool/roof edge; gm1152 has a purple patch beyond the right edge. A still image alone cannot establish whether each is an authored overflow plane or an incorrectly retained flat water child. Do not delete or resize without the new renderer diagnostics and native active-state evidence.

Latest UIFlows solution-preview still is dry. The geometry/inventory preview is visible and fits, but this early screenshot cannot establish delayed water propagation or victory; use settled water-front/gameplay evidence for those conclusions.

Existing standalone gm1699 solution is older than the new shared-palette representative run. Its rendered board and pools are present, but a new fix-case capture is needed to assess the latest color implementation. It is not in this35-level representative list.

equivalenceClaim: This is a visual review of specific Unity captures, not proof of full original binary/animation equivalence. Menu animation, actual motion and original state/flow timing are assessed separately.
